note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: A widely-reported Jul 17 target passed (a fourth slip) after Google scrapped the base architecture for a ground-up rebuild; still in limited Vertex preview. Polymarket 'next Gemini Pro by Aug 7' ~73%.
Polymarket 'GPT-6 released by' 89% for Dec 31 (75% Sep 30, 36% Aug 31). OpenAI's newest flagship work is the GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna suite (shipped Jul 9); no GPT-6 yet.

Moonshot promised full open weights (Modified MIT) for its 2.8T-param K3 by Jul 27; already live via API at AA 57. Weights run ~1.4TB even at 4-bit MXFP4, so realistic hosts are clouds, not workstations.
Manifold 'Grok 5 before Sep 2026' ~16%; V9 foundation reportedly still training on Colossus 2 after the Jul 8 Grok 4.5 launch.
Google confirmed Jul 21 that Gemini 4 pre-training has begun; no dated market yet.
